extraction_text: The Employer shall supply necessary forms to the employee to notify the Employer of any update on new tools brought on the job and both the employee and the Employer representative shall sign in duplicate with both parties keeping a copy.

attributes.context: The surrounding text frames the provision as a New Technology or Automation Clause addressing employer and employee procedures for new tools introduced on the job.
